d: Own money, own name, no press access or comped balance. Every figure on the site comes from an account that could be frozen like anyone else's.
At least three sizes per operator, from the minimum to four figures, timed from confirmed request to first on-chain broadcast so network congestion is excluded.
Open each tracked title inside the operator's own client and read the stated return. This is how we catch reduced builds that the lobby does not disclose.
Wagering, weighting, caps, expiry and max bet, copied from the operator's own page on the date of test, then flagged where they materially limit withdrawal.
One simple, one about a withdrawal, one deliberately ambiguous, across time zones. We record first reply and resolution.
Every operator is re-tested at least quarterly, and immediately if a reader reports a change we can reproduce. Each page carries the date of its last pass.
